flags.message: gemini-baseline's retrieval.md reports no retrieval beyond provisioned inputs and the statpack, but its harness transcript records two fedcourts query attempts: a SCOTUS denied-case query and a general SCOTUS query, both with decided-before 2026-09-17. Both results are unobserved, so success, contents, and transfer counts cannot be inferred. This is an incomplete attempt log, not evidence of this petition's outcome leaking; the forward leakage assessment remains not_applicable.
